record.one_liner: Aircall is a cloud-based business phone and call center platform that integrates with CRMs and helpdesks for calling, SMS, and conversation analytics.
record.auth_notes: Basic Auth (api_id as username, api_token as password) for customers accessing their own account. OAuth 2.0 for Technology Partners building multi-company apps; tokens are sent as Bearer and don't expire. OAuth client_id/secret must be requested from Aircall via the partner signup form.
record.access_notes: Basic Auth keys are created by a company admin in Company Settings > API Keys, which requires an existing Aircall account. I found no free tier or sandbox on the pages I fetched. The docs don't state a minimum plan for the public API, so the plan requirement is unverified; the "paid_plan" label is inferred from needing an Aircall account. OAuth requires partner signup and Aircall issuing credentials. Some features need entitlements (Analytics+, AI Assist, Conversations enabled by Aircall).
record.blocker: Needs a paid Aircall account with admin rights for Basic Auth keys (no free or sandbox path found). Multi-tenant OAuth needs partner approval. Rate limit is 120 requests/min per company. Calls and Contacts lists cap at 10,000 items. Users V1 endpoints are being deprecated. Aircall has no official MCP server per its FAQ (updated 2026-09-04); only third-party ones exist.
